scope_justification: Corporata is the Kingdom of human-made constructions — the root of the taxonomy itself, defined by human authorship.
A nation is a human-made political and legal construct — a collective agreement about territory, sovereignty, and membership. It persists through institutions, law, and shared narrative.
A business corporation is a legal fiction created by human law — a person in the legal sense, with rights and obligations, persisting independently of its individual members.
The word "tree" is a human-made linguistic construct — a sound-pattern assigned by convention to a category of organisms. The word, not the organism, is the construct.
A jacket is a human-made physical artifact — designed, manufactured, and structured to persist as a garment through material construction.
